tflite_model.note: Ultralytics TFLite exporter requires full tensorflow/tf-keras package or flatbuffers compiler: LiteRT export only supported on Linux x86 and macOS

caveat: Measured on a generic 12-class insect-ID dataset (Ants/Bees/Beetles/etc.), NOT on the project's real Kenyan pest/disease taxonomy — this validates the pipeline end-to-end, not real-world detection accuracy on any of the 15 target classes. Measured directly on Intel Core Ultra CPU proxy (batch=1, imgsz=384). ONNX export is 100% verified on disk (11.6 MB, 15.5 ms mean inference). Real physical Android phone deployment will depend on mobile SoC (e.g. MediaTek Helio G85 vs Snapdragon 680) and may exhibit 1.5x-2.5x higher latency without NPU acceleration.
